paper.title_en: Revisit Weak Cosmic Censorship in Einstein-Maxwell-Dilaton Black Holes: Third-order Protection, Swampland Distance Conjecture, and Weak Gravity Conjectures
paper.abstract_en: We extend the earlier analysis of cosmic censorship and the Weak Gravity Conjecture (WGC) in Einstein--Maxwell-dilaton (EMD) theory by performing a complete higher-order Sorce--Wald gedankenexperiment on the static charged Gibbons--Maeda--Garfinkle--Horowitz--Strominger (GMG) black hole. In the probe limit, an extremal GMG black hole can apparently be overcharged by a test particle, seemingly violating the weak cosmic censorship conjecture (WCCC), which is nothing but first-order variational identity in the Iyer--Wald formalism. This window can be closed by either incorporating backreaction via the Hoop Conjecture or further including second-order variational identities. In this paper, we explicitly compute third-order variational identities. The extremality parameter eta remains non-negative to the third perturbative orders confirming WCCC protection, regardless of the apparent failure of all-order generalization, model-independent proof of Lu, et al.. We further incorporate the Swampland Distance Conjecture (SDC): the resulting infinite tower of light charged states discharges any would-be overcharged configuration on a timescale tau much less than 2M, exponentially faster than a horizon can be destroyed, reinforcing WCCC in dynamical regimes and strongly relaxing the original WGC charge-to-mass bound.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 论文对极端GMG黑洞进行了完整的Sorçe–Wald思考实验，计算到三阶变分恒等式，并整合了沼泽地距离猜想和弱引力猜想，深入探讨了弱宇宙监督猜想，主题相关且理论深度高。
decision.title_zh: 重访爱因斯坦-麦克斯韦-迪拉顿黑洞中的弱宇宙监督：三阶保护、沼泽地距离猜想和弱引力猜想
decision.abstract_zh: 我们通过在静态带电Gibbons–Maeda–Garfinkle–Horowitz–Strominger（GMG）黑洞上执行完整的更高阶Sorçe–Wald思想实验，扩展了先前在爱因斯坦-麦克斯韦-迪拉顿（EMD）理论中对宇宙监督和弱引力猜想（WGC）的分析。在探针极限下，极端GMG黑洞似乎可以被测试粒子过度充电，表面上违反了弱宇宙监督猜想（WCCC），这不过是Iyer–Wald形式中的一阶变分恒等式。这个窗口可以通过结合回反应（Hoop猜想）或进一步包括二阶变分恒等式来关闭。在本文中，我们显式计算了三阶变分恒等式。极端性参数eta在到三阶微扰阶上保持非负，确认了WCCC的保护，无论Lu等人对所有阶推广的模型独立证明表面上是否失败。我们进一步整合了沼泽地距离猜想（SDC）：由此产生的无限光荷电态塔会在远小于2M的时间尺度tau上放电任何可能过度充电的构型，比视界被破坏的速度快指数级，在动态区域加强了WCCC，并强烈放宽了原始WGC荷质比界限。
keywords_zh: 爱因斯坦-麦克斯韦-迪拉顿理论
